item.title: Roll Own VPN AdBlock Service
item.description:
It’s actually super cheap & easy. The setup below costs a few dollars a year and uses ~20MB RAM total:

  • Get a VPN Provider
  • Install OpenVPN & setup client certs with https://github.com/Nyr/openvpn-install
  • Setup your hosts file with http://winhelp2002.mvps.org/hosts.txt
